qa.title: Q2186 (Jul. 10, 2026)
qa.question: If this follower's activated ability is in effect, does targeting it with a Dead to Rights still reduce its attack and defense by 2?
qa.answer: Yes. Modifying defense isn't the same as dealing damage.

qa.title: Q2185 (Jul. 10, 2026)
qa.question: I play this follower's activated ability. At the start of my end phase, I summon a Bansai Suzuki, Clone Technique token. If my opponent targets it with a Warped Progress at Quick timing, does it still take damage?
qa.answer: Yes. It wasn't on your field when you played this follower's activated ability, so it can still take damage.

qa.title: Q2184 (Jul. 10, 2026)
qa.question: At the start of my end phase, I summon a Bansai Suzuki, Clone Technique token. Does its "At the start of your end phase" ability then trigger?
qa.answer: No. It wasn't on your field at the start of your end phase.
